talent.question: Compare the two strongest candidates for a forward-deployed engineer role.
talent.judgeNote: Answer covers rubric requirements and presents a clear trade‑off.
talent.answer:
**Top forward‑deployed engineer candidates**

| Candidate | Relevant Experience | Customer‑facing style | Technical depth | Travel / availability | Notable trade‑off |
|-----------|--------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|-----------------------|-------------------|
| **Jonas Lindqvist** | Forward Deployed Engineer at Palinode Systems (2023‑present) – built prototype pipelines in customer stacks, shipped a document‑intake pipeline that cut claim triage from 3 days to <4 hours; wrote evaluation harness used for regression testing【2】 | Strong communicator, pushes back on scope in a way customers like; “allergic to tickets” and prefers owning outcomes rather than backlog work【1】 | Embedded work across manufacturing and insurance; hands‑on prototype delivery and evaluation tooling【2】 | Willing to travel up to 30%【1】 | **Trade‑off:** Very strong at front‑end customer interaction and rapid prototyping, but less evidence of deep integration‑engineer experience (e.g., OAuth broker, high‑volume webhook handling). |
| **Nino Beridze** | AI Solutions Engineer – combines integration depth with production LLM work; runs coding‑agent pipelines, reviews every diff, has run a product end‑to‑end alone【5】 | Comfortable with coding agents; no explicit note on customer‑facing style, but “real production LLM work” implies delivery to users; would start part‑time before full‑time【5】 | Deep integration experience plus LLM production; reviews code diffs, indicating strong engineering rigor【5】 | No travel constraints mentioned; can transition from part‑time to full‑time【5】 | **Trade‑off:** Brings rare mix of integration depth and LLM production, but less documented as a front‑line communicator who can push back on scope like Jonas. |

**Overall comparison**

- **Customer interaction:** Jonas excels at communicating and managing scope with customers, a core forward‑deployed skill【1】. Nino’s profile does not highlight this strength, so you may need to supplement with support on the customer‑facing side.  
- **Technical breadth:** Nino offers a unique blend of deep integration work and production LLM experience, which is valuable for AI‑centric deployments【5】. Jonas provides solid prototype delivery and evaluation tooling but lacks explicit LLM production experience.  
- **Availability & logistics:** Jonas is ready for a role with up to 30 % travel【1】; Nino can begin part‑time and move to full‑time, with no travel requirement noted【5】.  

**Recommendation:** Choose **Jonas Lindqvist** if the role prioritizes strong customer communication, rapid prototyping, and willingness to travel. Choose **Nino Beridze** if the role demands deep integration expertise combined with production LLM capabilities and can accommodate a ramp‑up period.
